stories.title: Holmes Gem Wasted — Bullpen Blows 4-0 Lead, Series Tied
stories.angle: Holmes threw 7 scoreless innings (5 K, 0 ER) but the bullpen collapsed. Palencia allowed 3 in the 8th; Waldschmidt pinch-hit walk-off 2-run homer in the 9th. Per has_score=False insight, leads with Holmes' stat line — NOT the 5-4 final. Series now TIED 1-1.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Seven scoreless innings. Five strikeouts. Zero earned runs.

Holmes was masterful — 1 ER in 26 innings across his last four starts.

The bullpen handed it back in the eighth and ninth.

Series tied. Rubber game today at 2:40 PM CT.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Clay Holmes Deserves Better — 26 IP, 1 ER Across Last 4 Starts
stories.angle: Holmes has been quietly elite all month. 26 innings, 1 earned run across his last four starts is ace-level production. He pitched brilliantly and took the no-decision. Bold fan take: he's building his October case.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes deserves better.

Seven scoreless innings Tuesday. Walked off by the bullpen.

Last four starts: 26 innings, 1 earned run. That's what ace-level pitching looks like.

He's making his case for October.

#Cubs #MLB #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Wild Card Standings — D-backs Chasing WC3, Rubber Game Has Real Stakes
stories.angle: Full NL Wild Card standings table. Cubs WC1 (76-57), Phillies WC2 (73-59), Padres WC3 (71-61), D-backs bubble (70-63). Today's rubber match is a direct battle against a WC competitor.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
NL Wild Card entering Wednesday:

WC1: Cubs 76-57
WC2: Phillies 73-59
WC3: Padres 71-61
On the bubble: D-backs 70-63 (today's opponent)

This afternoon's rubber game is worth more than just a series win. Arizona's hunting the same postseason spot.

#Cubs #MLB #NorthSiders

stories.title: Series Finale Preview — Boyd vs Rodriguez, 2:40 PM CT
stories.angle: Head-to-head pitcher breakdown: Boyd (8-2, 4.15 ERA) vs Rodriguez (10-4, 2.71 ERA). Rodriguez has the edge on ERA but Boyd's 8 wins show effectiveness. Rubber match energy.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Rubber game. Chase Field. 2:40 PM CT.

Boyd (8-2, 4.15 ERA) vs E-Rod (10-4, 2.71 ERA).

Rodriguez has the edge on paper. Boyd's been tough when it matters — 8 wins for a reason.

Cubs took one. D-backs took one. Settle it this afternoon.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Roster Move — Taillon DFA'd, Wantz Up
stories.angle: Cubs tighten the October roster. With Boyd, Gausman, Holmes, Imanaga all healthy, Taillon was redundant. Wantz adds bullpen depth — especially relevant after last night's bullpen collapse.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Cubs DFA Jameson Taillon, call up Andrew Wantz.

With Boyd, Gausman, Holmes, and Imanaga all healthy — Taillon's roster spot was never safe.

Wantz adds bullpen depth for the stretch run. Especially timely after last night.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: First Pitch Hype — Rubber Game, 2:40 PM CT
stories.angle: Series tied. Boyd on the mound. Cubs' 2.5-game WC1 lead on the line vs a direct bubble team. Simple, punchy game-time energy.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Boyd. Chase Field. Rubber game.

The Cubs and D-backs each took one. Now 9 innings decide the series — and Chicago's 2.5-game WC1 lead.

2:40 PM CT. Let's go.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
